title: Equipping the Saints
definition: Equipping the Saints is the ministry of preparing believers for service, maturity, unity, and faithfulness in Christ.
summary: Equipping the Saints is the Church's work of preparing believers for ministry, maturity, and service.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives ministry gifts to build up His body toward maturity.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on training the whole body, not keeping ministry in the hands of a few visible leaders. Christ gives leaders to equip saints so the body builds itself up in love. Equipping includes doctrine, character, skills, discernment, and opportunities to serve.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches become unhealthy when members remain passive spectators. Equipping honors the gifts Christ has placed throughout His body and moves believers toward fruitful participation. It also prevents burnout by distributing ministry according to God's design.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where you need training and where you can help train others. Move from attendance toward participation as God enables. Leaders should measure success not only by what they do, but by whom they are equipping.
